**`merge_sorted_lists.py`** — two-pointer merge, O(n+m) time:
```python
def merge_sorted_lists(a, b):
    result = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        if a[i] <= b[j]:
            result.append(a[i]); i += 1
        else:
            result.append(b[j]); j += 1
    result.extend(a[i:])
    result.extend(b[j:])
    return result
```

- Equal lists
- Negative numbers
